one_liner: Land AI consulting retainers via 100+ local conversations; productize cohorts plus $5K–$10K/mo implementation offers.

why_it_works: SMBs want outcomes not tools; warm network sales beat cold ads early; retainers compound once trust is earned.

why_it_works: Amazon already has intent traffic; creators monetize via shoppable video without holding inventory.

one_liner: Start with a cheap inflatable screen on Marketplace, take HOA/private bookings, then upgrade to commercial outdoor/indoor kits.

why_it_works: Restaurants get a free amenity; advertisers buy hyperlocal visibility; physical placement creates warm intros for upsells.

why_it_works: Unique stays price higher; content can fill calendar before open; experience differentiation beats commodity Airbnbs.

why_it_works: Commoditized AI copy makes authentic SME writing scarcer; buyers still pay for voice, research, and trust.

why_it_works: Government pays reliably; many contracts don't require you to be the labor; historical award data informs bids.

Maps density (30+ companies / 100+ reviews) signals existing demand; partner with a strong operator who is weak at marketing.
